source_verification_receipts.version: Management Science 69(7), 2023, pp. 3759–3777; primary publisher record inspected
source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher abstract and Volume 69(7) bibliographic record; theorem text was not accessible on the rendered primary page
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The primary record confirms the journal publication and its minimax switchback-design framework under assumptions on carryover order, with design-based inference. The exact Theorem 2 wording was corroborated in the arXiv manuscript at https://arxiv.org/pdf/2009.00148, pp. 12–13, but should be source-verified against the publisher PDF before any formula-level comparison.
Assumption 2 imposes specified m-carryover, and Theorem 2 gives a minimax optimal multi-unit spillover/carryover design under Assumptions 1–4.

The paper derives geometric-mixing and burn-in bias–variance tradeoffs: its regular-switchback GATE result has T^{-1/3} root-MSE behavior, while a stable-effect burn-in regime has O(sqrt(log(T)/T)) MSE.
The paper studies one aggregate-unit continuous-time switchbacks, gives a carryover/correlation switching-frequency bias–variance tradeoff, and proposes an empirical-Bayes design.
The paper's carryover extension is first order: treatments before t−1 do not affect Y_{i,t}, and its blocked SRSB design targets the associated stay-group estimand.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Primary DOI record; corroborating author preprint https://arxiv.org/abs/1009.1016, Sections 2–3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work develops a data-driven pairwise bandwidth-selection rule with oracle inequalities and adaptive minimax density estimation; it is a methodological template rather than a switchback result.
The paper proves constrained-risk inequalities for general losses, including non-decreasing losses applicable to absolute-loss lower-bound arguments.
The paper models treatment and control as unknown Markov chains and constructs an adaptive online design that is consistent and asymptotically efficient under that model.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace E_{\mathsf S_T} throughout with expectation under an explicitly named full randomized-design kernel that integrates both the public renewal schedule and the fair run-arm coins; then restate measurability of the selector under that kernel.
Make prop:finite-order-scope conditional on C>0 and give a bounded explicit weighted-lag witness, with amplitude min\{B,C(2+m)^{-(1+\beta)}\}/2.
Add GlynnJohariRasouli2020 to related work and explain why its Markov/MLE adaptive gain does not supply information about \beta for an adversarial fixed potential-outcome array.
Add a valid selected-design variance estimator and a design-based limit-law/coverage target after the oracle inequality is repaired, making the adaptive design operational for inference.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two well-posedness defects and add the missing adaptive-temporal-interference comparator, then return this angle to Stage 0.
